title: A Fish Looked in a Mirror, Saw a Mark, and Tried to Scrub It Off
subject: cleaner wrasse

scenes.text: A fish saw a mark on itself in a mirror. Then it tried to scrub it off.
Scientists gave cleaner wrasse a colored mark on the throat, a spot they can only see in a mirror.
With no mirror, the fish ignored it. A clear, colorless mark? Ignored too.
But with a mirror and a colored mark, they scraped their bodies against the bottom, as if trying to rub it off.
That's the classic mirror test, and very few animals pass it. The study came out in 2019.
Some scientists still argue about what it proves. But a fish tried to scrub itself clean.
